description: The returned original shows an opaque dark teal floor-length court gown with low square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves, gold geometric woven borders and a decorated belt with round clasp. A pale patterned wrap hangs over the forearms; a lighter underdress shows in the lower walking opening, with dark embroidered shoes. No headgear, armor or weapon is visible. Plain stone doorway and paving surround the complete standing figure.
